prompt: My company makes project management software for small construction contractors (invoicing, scheduling, job costing). Our site inventoryapp.com currently has just a homepage, a features page, and a pricing page. We have zero content strategy and don't know what to write about. How should we approach getting organic search traffic?

assertions.name: uses-required-output-format
assertions.text: Response contains all required sections: Executive Summary, Biggest Opportunities, Critical Issues, SEO Analysis, Recommended Actions, Implementation Roadmap.

assertions.name: organizes-by-topic-clusters
assertions.text: Response structures content around topic clusters with pillars and supporting pages rather than a flat keyword list.

assertions.name: intent-based-content
assertions.text: Response maps content to informational, commercial, and transactional intent and prioritizes commercial-intent pages.

assertions.name: includes-internal-linking
assertions.text: Response specifies an internal linking model (e.g., hub-and-spoke) connecting content to product/money pages.

assertions.name: no-fabricated-metrics
assertions.text: Response does not invent search volumes, rankings, or traffic; unavailable data is explicitly flagged.
